summary: Ensemble aggregate is very high (97%), indicating strong overall expectation that a 1B worldwide film will occur before May 1, 2026.
Objections identify credible downside risks (China policy, production delays, slate crowding, and IP concentration) that could modestly reduce the odds.
Recent 2025–2026 milestones (Lilo & Stitch, Zootopia 2, Avatar: Fire and Ash) demonstrate strong upside momentum supporting the base case.
Adjusted probability downward from the raw ensemble to 0.93 to reflect identified risks while preserving the high-probability base.

justification.critique_assessment: Valid and credible objections identify real downside risks (China policy, production delays, and IP concentration) that warrant a cautious downward adjustment; the 'certain' framing in the threshold analysis is overstated.
justification.adjustment: Adjusted from 0.97 to 0.93 to incorporate the legitimate downside risks without discarding the strong upward momentum from recent and projected 1B performances.
